up: Return the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and PubMed ID or DOI for compounds tested against the human CB1 cannabinoid receptor (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL218). Only include compounds that have an IC50 value (in nM) and for which a SMILES string exists, along with an associated PubMed ID or DOI. For each compound, include the IC50 value (in nM).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL218' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL)
